item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 05/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A strong easterly airstream will affect the coastal areas of Guangdong tomorrow. A cold front will reach the coast of southern China next Monday. Under the influence of the continental airstream, it will be cooler in the morning and fine over southern China in the following couple of days.

Date/Month: 06/03 (Sunday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two rain patches. Misty in the morning.
Temp range: 18 - 22 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 07/03 (Monday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few rain patches in the morning. Becoming fine and dry in the afternoon.
Temp range: 17 - 23 C
R.H. range: 60 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
